'''Santi López Prats'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|López|Prats}} (born 24 March 1975) is an Andorran [[Alpine skiing|alpine skier]]. He competed in the [[Alpine skiing at the 1994 Winter Olympics – Men's super-G|men's super-G]] at the [[1994 Winter Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/lo/santi-lopez-1.html |title=Santi López |access-date=29 March 2018 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161203134406/http://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/lo/santi-lopez-1.html |archive-date=3 December 2016 |quote=Full name: Santi López Prats}}</ref>
